description: This script schedules automatic system reboots by setting cron jobs based on maintenance windows, device time offset, and synchronization status. It manages concurrency with file locks and retries, and calculates random reboot times within specified windows.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a random reboot time within the maintenance window, adjusting for device time offset and device type.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules a cron job for reboot at the calculated time, either on a specific date or in the next maintenance window.
